verdict.rationale: Message-history retention on a free tier is a fair question for a team chat platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers whether free servers keep full access to older messages. The Nitro pages list paid perks such as upload sizes, emoji and streaming, and say nothing about history limits or retention.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can keep my team on a free tier without losing access to older message history
